description: QRadioPredict is provided by QDeltaSoft. QRadioPredict calculates VHF/UHF propagation using Longley–Rice and ITWOM. It supports fixed and mobile stations, coverage plots, SRTM elevation inputs, land-cover effects and antenna patterns, with a documented connection to FlightGear. Geographic context: global (software applicability). Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here.
